hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use elevated charcoal surfaces (not pure black). Apple/Linear aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for sections to create an airy, premium feel.
visual_enhancers.logo_f: Letter F in metallic gold constructed as a film strip (vertical rod with sprocket holes, two solid arms), in a rounded square tile with subtle glow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Subtle backdrop-blur-xl on sticky nav and floating elements with bg-white/5.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the 11-card Features section, use a highly asymmetrical bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) mixing tall, wide, and square cards.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align text for editorial feel; center-align only specific stats or final CTAs.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, clip-path).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Fade-in and slight translate-y on scroll for sections.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Hover zoom on images (scale 1.05 with smooth transition), metallic shimmer on buttons.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle 3D/parallax moment in the hero section.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for trust chips or conceptual keywords.

accessibility_and_ux.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use text-shadow if overlaid on images.
accessibility_and_ux.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using tailwindcss. DO NOT USE SHADCN CARDS for marketing sections; use raw HTML/divs with tailwind for highly custom bento grids and layouts.
Include 'framer-motion' for all scroll reveals and the hero masked line-by-line reveal.
Implement the exact color palette specified: #0C0C0E background, #F5F1E8 text, and #C5A059 gold accent. Do NOT use any blue or purple.
For the 'Frame F' logo, create a custom SVG component that matches the description (film strip aesthetic with gold metallic gradient).
All copy should be in Italian by default, with an IT/EN toggle placeholder in the nav.
Do NOT center-align everything. Use editorial left-alignment where appropriate.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
For images, use the provided Unsplash URLs or valid functional equivalents.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories for images = use functional equivalents. DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDER TEXT.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
